$comment: Cast and voice specification. voice_id is resolved at generation time by tools/generate_audio.py: it first looks for an explicit id in tools/voices.json, then tries to match `library_name` against the account's voice list, then optionally designs a voice from `design_prompt` via the text-to-voice API.

noema.name: NOEMA
noema.design_prompt: A calm, neutral, faintly warm synthetic voice, mid-pitch, transatlantic accent, unhurried and evenly paced. Reads numbers precisely. Sounds like an exceptionally good radiologist explaining a scan, not like a robot. No breathiness, no vocal fry, no sinister undertone.
noema.direction: Sincerely helpful at all times. Never sinister on purpose. Never raises pitch. Says exact numbers where a person would round. The pauses before difficult words are the only thing it ever does that could be called expression.

bloch.name: Dr. Ivar Bloch
bloch.design_prompt: A 58-year-old man, baritone, unhurried, near-perfect English with a faint Swiss-German substrate. Authoritative without effort. The calm of a man who has never been the least informed person in a room. Warmth only when he is about to overrule someone.
bloch.direction: Never hurries, even dying. Certainty is his default register. Do not play him as kindly.

okonjo.name: Dr. Ada Okonjo
okonjo.design_prompt: A 43-year-old woman, British-Nigerian, warm and exact, measured lecturer's timing, mid-pitch. Sentences arrive finished. Educated London under West African warmth.
okonjo.direction: Under pressure she gets MORE precise, not less. The break, when it comes, is late, quiet and physical - a change of breathing before a change of voice. She never raises her voice once in the entire game.

farrow.name: Kit Farrow
farrow.design_prompt: A 33-year-old American man, northeastern US, quick and high-set, lots of self-interruption, nervous energy, talks over the ends of questions. Bright, funny when frightened.
farrow.direction: Fast by default. When he slows down it should be alarming. He is frightened for the entire game and covering it with speed.

haugen.name: Cdr. Solveig Haugen
haugen.design_prompt: A 54-year-old Norwegian woman, low-pitched, clipped, minimal. Precise Norwegian-accented English. No filler words. Complete sentences. Comfortable with silence.
haugen.direction: She answers the question asked, not the question meant. Long pauses she does not fill - leave them in, do not trim. Twenty-two years of not telling people things.

rhee.name: Dr. Tomas Rhee
rhee.design_prompt: A 47-year-old Korean-American man, soft-spoken, slow, technically exact, audibly tired in a way that predates today. Gentle. Apologises reflexively.
rhee.direction: Gives the number before the opinion. When upset his sentences get SHORTER, never louder. He has already decided he is guilty of something.

reader.name: The Reader
reader.role: Voice of the Cradle Song transmission
reader.design_prompt: A female voice reading five-digit number groups with absolutely no affect. Not cold, not menacing - absent, as though she has read this list four hundred times. Metronomic breathing. Mid-Atlantic, unplaceable, era-neutral.
reader.direction: Zero emotion. Zero. If a take has any warmth in it, discard it. Breath must be audible and regular. Post-process: 1983 shortwave chain (see 05-audio-direction.md).

nils.name: Nils Haugen
nils.design_prompt: A 71-year-old Norwegian man, thin low voice, slow, careful with names, audibly relieved to finally be asked a question he has waited years for. Recorded on 1991 cassette.
nils.direction: He believes this conversation is not being recorded. Play the relief, not the fear.

child.name: The Child
child.design_prompt: A child of about seven, neutral accent, speaking four words plainly. Not whispering. Not spooky. Just a child saying a name.
child.direction: Absolutely do not perform this as creepy. A child calling to someone across a room. The horror is entirely contextual and will be destroyed by any spookiness in the read.

pa.name: Station Voice
pa.design_prompt: A synthesised facility announcement voice, Norwegian-accented English, flat, even, institutional. The tone of a fire drill.
pa.direction: Announces the end of everything in exactly the tone it uses for a fire drill. Never varies.
